Topic 1.3: Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. learners apply colour on drawn plant pictures for aesthetic value 75
2. appreciate own an others coloured work. in groups drawn items their colored

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. learners apply colour on drawn plant pictures for aesthetic value 75
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to learners apply colour on drawn plant pictures for aesthetic value 75. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate own an others coloured work. in groups drawn items their colored
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own an others coloured work. in groups drawn items their colored. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: learners apply colour on drawn plant pictures for aesthetic value 75
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Coloring MAKING TECHNIQUES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
